Package com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.manager

Class ControlManager

java.lang.Object
com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.manager.ControlManager
public class ControlManager extends Object
The ControlManager class manages the user interface controls for the application. It uses ControlP5 for creating and handling UI elements such as sliders, buttons, and dropdown lists. This class also manages the toggling and view selection for output methods (NDI, Spout, Syphon).
